not_done_and_why.manifest_submission: no resolved subject set exists to submit
not_done_and_why.successor_index: an index bound to zero new contracts would restate the current one under a new digest
not_done_and_why.successor_selection_design: a design bound to an empty universe is not a design

column_to_variable.meaning: these columns are DERIVED features — technical and statistical indicators computed downstream of the lake — so no conceptual variable of the 1,965-variable census carries them. They have no lake provenance to inherit; their availability is a property of the DERIVATION, which is not yet declared anywhere.

what_the_bridge_established.subset_note: the 83 RL feature_columns are a STRICT SUBSET of the 94 columns of the supervised model-ready view: both consumers read the same physical view. This closes the observation_contract-versus-feature_columns gap by physical evidence rather than by a configuration match, which is why no configuration was edited.

variable_to_entity.meaning: OPEN, HIGH, LOW, CLOSE and VOLUME each exist on 128 entities of the lake. The view does not declare WHICH instrument it drew them from, and a bridge never chooses between 128 candidates.

what_would_unblock_it.gap: the derivation contract of the 89 engineered columns
what_would_unblock_it.needed: a producer artifact naming, per engineered column, the lake variables it consumes and the lag its computation introduces
what_would_unblock_it.who_holds_it: the feature-engineering producer, not the owner

what_would_unblock_it.gap: the instrument binding of the 5 OHLCV columns
what_would_unblock_it.needed: the model-ready view declaring the entity it was built from (symbol and timeframe), which the view's own manifest could carry

what_would_unblock_it.gap: the eight availability fields per family
what_would_unblock_it.needed: provider, observation and available timestamp columns, revision policy, timezone, latency and license scope, from a worker or provider statement

why: the bridge resolved 0 of 94 consumed columns to a family with a complete temporal contract, so there is no non-empty resolved set for a manifest submission, a successor index or a successor selection design to bind. Per C29 the disposition governs and no selection is executed.
zero_is_a_valid_answer: the goal was never a positive count; forcing one would have required inventing an availability the sources do not state
